basic_information.short_title: Unayan Municipal Hospital Upgrading Act of 2022
basic_information.official_title: AN ACT UPGRADING THE UNAYAN MUNICIPAL HOSPITAL IN MUNICIPALITY OF BINIDAYAN, LANAO DEL SUR, INTO A FIFTY (50) BED CAPACITY DISTRICT HOSPITAL AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
signed_by: Prof. Raby B. Angkal, Secretary General
basic_information.effectivity: 15 days after publication in a newspaper of regional circulation

citizen_summary.what_is_this_about: Turns the Unayan Municipal Hospital in Binidayan, Lanao del Sur, into a 50-bed district hospital — 5 times its current capacity — and renames it the Unayan District Hospital.
citizen_summary.why_was_it_proposed: The Organic Law duty to provide comprehensive and integrated health service delivery and establish a general hospital system by law.
citizen_summary.what_will_change: A ten-bed municipal hospital becomes a fifty-bed district hospital, with buildings, equipment, facilities, operating funds and personnel upgraded to the prescribed standards, and a new name to match its new status.
who_will_be_affected: Residents of Binidayan and the wider Unayan area of Lanao del Sur
Patients previously limited to a ten-bed facility
Hospital staff, whose posts and funding are upgraded
citizen_summary.when_will_it_take_effect: In force since 2022. Delivery depends on the annual Bangsamoro budget.

what_this_means_for_you.in_short: NOW LAW. Unayan Municipal Hospital becomes Unayan District Hospital, with 50 authorised beds instead of 10.
in_practice: The facility is reclassified from municipal to district hospital
It is renamed the Unayan District Hospital
Buildings, landscaping, equipment, operating funds and personnel upgraded to the prescribed standards
The hospital integrates the Universal Health Care Act
Under the administrative supervision of the Ministry of Health

for_specific_groups.Patients: 5 times the beds, and district rather than municipal classification.
for_specific_groups.Hospital staff: Personnel are expressly upgraded along with the facility.
for_specific_groups.PhilHealth members: Section 4 requires integration of the Universal Health Care Act.

what_this_means_for_you.when_you_will_feel_it: In force since 2022; construction and staffing depend on annual appropriations.
what_you_can_do: Ask MOH-BARMM about the implementing rules, due within 60 days of enactment

key_terms_explained.Authorized bed capacity: The number of beds the hospital may legally operate.
key_terms_explained.UHC Act: Republic Act 11223, the national Universal Health Care law.

key_provisions: Section 1 — Short title: the “Unayan Municipal Hospital Upgrading Act of 2022”.
Section 2 — Policy grounded on Section 22, Article IX of the Organic Law: comprehensive and integrated health service delivery and a general hospital system established by law.

Section 3 — Upgrades the existing Unayan Municipal Hospital from ten authorised beds into a District Hospital with fifty authorised beds, to be known as the Unayan District Hospital. Existing buildings including landscaping, medical and office equipment and other facilities, together with operating funds and personnel, are upgraded to include the construction and procurement needed to meet the prescribed standards.
Section 4 — The hospital shall integrate all relevant provisions of Republic Act 11223, the Universal Health Care Act.
Section 5 — The hospital is under the administrative supervision of the Ministry of Health, which determines and approves its organisational structure.

Section 6 — Funding is appropriated from the Bangsamoro General Appropriations for the upgrading, including infrastructure, medical and office equipment and the annual operating budget, and thereafter such amount as may be needed.
Section 7 — MOH-BARMM shall promulgate implementing rules within 60 days after enactment.
Section 9 — Repeals inconsistent BARMM laws, including those passed under the defunct ARMM, on the operations of the Unayan Municipal Hospital.
Section 10 — Takes effect 15 days after publication in a newspaper of regional circulation.
